messages.subject: [Service Status Announcement] Metrics system outage
parts:
Hi all,

We are currently experiencing an outage with our metrics system. Users are unable to view application or account usage metrics on the shinyapps.io dashboard. We are working with our vendor to resolve the issue and I will send a further update when the issue is resolved. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Thanks for using shinyapps.io

-Andy
